articles.title: Cross River Bank enters Bitcoin-backed lending with $250K loans
articles.summary: The US bank is offering Bitcoin-backed loans ranging from $10,000 to $250,000 through LendingUSA, allowing borrowers to access cash without selling their holdings.

articles.title: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler for $44 billion
articles.summary: The cybersecurity giant said that the deal to buy Zscaler, which provides zero-trust products to large enterprises, will better equip their customers to use AI agents.

articles.title: US and UK to host Women's World Cups in 2031 and 2035
articles.summary: FIFA has confirmed the United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica will host the 2031 Women's World Cup — the first to feature 48 teams. The UK will stage the 2035 edition, its first World Cup since 1966.

articles.title: Turkey: Authorities search for lioness on the loose in Istanbul
articles.summary: A lioness was on the loose in northern Istanbul, with wildlife advocates demanding answers over how the animal entered the country and who was keeping it in captivity.
